name: Pastures Of Eriviat Hall
description:
4 new undetected fields, we will open them all if we get the numbers 40acres. Parking will be on the field as it is hard standing as there is a track.
Dig fee - £20
16 & under free with supervision.
Toilet tent for the ladies and children
Free lunch available and hot & cold drinks ( decide closer to time what’s for lunch) also snacks
We have also spare equipment if needed if anyone fancies a try before buy.
Defib and first aid on site.
Moderators & admins on the fields please don’t hesitate to ask for help.
